paper_title: Lattice QCD input for axion cosmology
notes: This is a pure theory paper using lattice QCD calculations to compute the temperature-dependent QCD free energy. The authors use this to derive theoretical bounds on the axion mass from cosmological misalignment mechanism (m_a >= 14.6 μeV for post-inflation PQ-breaking). These are theoretical constraints from lattice QCD and cosmological arguments, not experimental or observational exclusion limits on axion coupling parameters. The paper does not report direct measurements or observations of axion couplings to any particles.
